title: Procurement Notice: Lead-Time Surcharge on Design Studio Selections Change Orders
content:
A fee-bearing change order on a Design Studio Selections file carries a lead-time surcharge set by the categories of the option lines the change order adds on a structural closed file:

- where it adds cabinetry or countertop lines, 150.00;
- where it adds flooring or appliance lines and no cabinetry or countertop lines, 75.00;
- otherwise, or on a file in any other status, nothing.

**The rule as a table**

| File status | Adds cabinetry or countertop lines | Adds flooring or appliance lines | Surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Structural closed | Yes | Yes or No | 150.00 |
| Structural closed | No | Yes | 75.00 |
| Structural closed | No | No | Nothing |
| Any other status | Any | Any | Nothing |

The categories are those on the option line entries added under the change order number.
